meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 在指定时间范围内查询会议纪要，汇总生成结构化报告（单日概览或周报），附会议时间、主题、纪要及逐字稿链接，并可为无纪要会议标注“无纪要”。
howto.when: 当用户提出整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾一段时间会议内容时触发，例如“整理这周会议纪要”或“总结最近的会议”。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: Claude 会查询本周会议并生成周报。
Claude 会汇总近7天会议并列出详情。
Claude 会按周报格式输出上周会议汇总。

howto.what_en: On installation, Claude can query meeting notes within a specified time range and produce a structured summary report (daily overview or weekly report) with meeting time, topic, notes and transcript links, marking meetings without notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings from a period, e.g., "organize this week's meeting notes" or "summarize recent meetings".

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Claude will query this week's meetings and generate a weekly report.

say_en.text: Summarize the meetings from the last 7 days
say_en.note: Claude will list details of meetings in the past 7 days.
Claude will output last week's meetings in weekly report format.
